# Docs

> Learn cubby on a single page: the platform, every API, and how to run your own.

- Category: reference
- Tags: documentation, guide, learning

Docs is an app on Cubby, a shelf of tiny static web apps
served by one PocketBase instance. It is plain HTML/JS/CSS with
hash routing (internal pages live at #/..., not real subpaths). It loads the cubby modules: core, platform, nav, draw, graph, preview.

Parts of the page may render in the browser, so its HTML can be an empty shell. The markdown snapshot below is what it shows, readable without running JavaScript.

## Links

- [Open the app](https://cubby.pockethost.io/docs/): Learn cubby on a single page: the platform, every API, and how to run your own.
- [Page content as markdown](https://cubby.pockethost.io/_cubby/content/docs): what the page renders, for agents that cannot run JavaScript
- Deep links: for a page URL https://cubby.pockethost.io/docs/#/<route>, fetch https://cubby.pockethost.io/_cubby/content/docs/<route> (404 route_not_found when the app has no content for that view)
- [All apps on this instance](https://cubby.pockethost.io/llms.txt): the site-wide index
